nodes.name: van der Waerden's Theorem
nodes.statement: For positive integers $k, r$ there exists $M = M(k,r)$ such that any $r$-coloring of $\{1,\dots,M\}$ has a monochromatic arithmetic progression of length $k$.
nodes.statement_clean: Any finite coloring of a sufficiently long initial segment of integers contains arbitrarily long monochromatic arithmetic progressions.
conclusions: $\exists M(k,r)$ s.t. any $r$-coloring of $\{1,\dots,M\}$ contains a monochromatic AP of length $k$

nodes.name: Szemeredi's Theorem
nodes.statement: For every $k$ and $\delta > 0$ there exists $N(k,\delta)$ such that every subset of $\{1,\dots,N\}$ of size $\ge \delta N$ contains an AP of length $k$.
nodes.statement_clean: Every dense subset of integers contains arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions.
conclusions: $\exists N(k,\delta)$ s.t. every $A \subseteq \{1,\dots,N\}$ with $|A| \ge \delta N$ contains AP of length $k$

nodes.name: Main Theorem (Quantitative Szemeredi)
nodes.statement: For every $k$ there is $c = c(k) > 0$ such that every subset of $\{1,\dots,N\}$ of size $\ge N(\log\log N)^{-c}$ contains an AP of length $k$. Moreover $c$ can be taken to be $2^{-2^{k+9}}$.
nodes.statement_clean: Quantitative version: density bound for finding length-$k$ APs is $(\log\log N)^{-c}$.
conclusions: Every $A \subseteq \{1,\dots,N\}$ with $|A| \ge N(\log\log N)^{-c}$ contains AP of length $k$

nodes.name: Discrete Fourier Transform on $\mathbb{Z}_N$
nodes.statement: For $f: \mathbb{Z}_N \to \mathbb{C}$ and $r \in \mathbb{Z}_N$, $\hat{f}(r) = \sum_{s \in \mathbb{Z}_N} f(s) \omega^{-rs}$, where $\omega = \exp(2\pi i/N)$.

nodes.name: Convolution
nodes.statement: $f * g(s) = \sum_{t \in \mathbb{Z}_N} f(t) \overline{g(t-s)}$. (Non-standard form used throughout the paper.)

nodes.name: Balanced function
nodes.statement: For $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ of cardinality $\delta N$, the balanced function is $f_A(s) = 1 - \delta$ if $s \in A$ and $f_A(s) = -\delta$ otherwise.

nodes.name: Fourth-power Fourier identity
nodes.statement: For $f, g: \mathbb{Z}_N \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sum_r |\hat{f}(r)|^2 |\hat{g}(r)|^2 = N \sum_t |\sum_s f(s)\overline{g(s-t)}|^2$.

nodes.name: Fourth power as additive quadruple count
nodes.statement: $\sum_r |\hat{f}(r)|^4 = N \sum_{a-b=c-d} f(a)\overline{f(b)}f(c)\overline{f(d)}$.

nodes.name: $\alpha$-uniform set/function
nodes.statement: $f: \mathbb{Z}_N \to D$ is $\alpha$-uniform if $\sum_k |\sum_s f(s)\overline{f(s-k)}|^2 \le \alpha N^3$. A set $A$ is $\alpha$-uniform if its balanced function is.

nodes.name: Equivalent Formulations of Uniformity
nodes.statement: Five conditions for $f: \mathbb{Z}_N \to D$ are equivalent up to constants: small $\sum_k|\sum_s f(s)\overline{f(s-k)}|^2$, small additive quadruple count, small $\sum_r|\hat{f}(r)|^4$, small $\max_r|\hat{f}(r)|$, and small inner-product variance against arbitrary $g$.
conclusions: The five formulations of $\alpha$-uniformity are equivalent up to fixed-power constants

nodes.name: Linear-progression partition lemma
nodes.statement: If $\varphi(x) = ax+b$ is linear and $rs \ge N$, then $\{0,\dots,r-1\}$ partitions into APs $P_1,\dots,P_M$ of length between $(rs/4N)^{1/2}$ and $(rs/N)^{1/2}$ on each of which $\varphi$ has diameter $\le s$.

nodes.name: Exponential-sum to AP partition (linear)
nodes.statement: If $|\sum_{x=0}^{r-1} f(x)\omega^{-\varphi(s)}| \ge \alpha r$ for $\varphi$ linear, then $\{0,\dots,r-1\}$ partitions into $m \le (8\pi r/\alpha)^{1/2}$ APs whose contributions $\sum_{P_j}f(x)$ sum to $\ge (\alpha/2)r$.

nodes.name: Large Fourier coefficient implies density increment
nodes.statement: If $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ satisfies $|\hat{A}(r)| \ge \alpha N$ for some $r \ne 0$, then there is an AP $P$ of length $\ge (\alpha^3 N/128\pi)^{1/2}$ with $|A \cap P| \ge (\delta + \alpha/8)|P|$.

nodes.name: Roth's Theorem
nodes.statement: If $\delta > 0$ and $N \ge \exp\exp(C\delta^{-1})$, then any $A \subseteq \{1,\dots,N\}$ with $|A| \ge \delta N$ contains an AP of length three.

nodes.name: Proof of Roth's Theorem
nodes.statement: Density-increment iteration: either $A$ is $\alpha$-uniform (gives many APs via Fourier count) or has a large non-trivial Fourier coefficient (gives a denser subprogression via CP339.2). Iterate.

nodes.name: Iterated difference function $\Delta(f; a_1,\dots,a_d)$
nodes.statement: $\Delta(f; a_1,\dots,a_d)(s) = \prod_{\epsilon \in \{0,1\}^d} (C^{|\epsilon|} f)(s - \sum_i a_i \epsilon_i)$, where $C$ denotes complex conjugation.

nodes.name: $\alpha$-uniformity of degree $d$
nodes.statement: $f: \mathbb{Z}_N \to D$ is $\alpha$-uniform of degree $d$ if $\sum_{a_1,\dots,a_d} |\sum_s \Delta(f; a_1,\dots,a_d)(s)|^2 \le \alpha N^{d+2}$. Quadratic ($d=2$), cubic ($d=3$).

nodes.name: Equivalent Formulations of Higher-Degree Uniformity
nodes.statement: Seven conditions characterizing $\alpha$-uniformity of degree $d$ are equivalent up to fixed-power constants, including conditions on $\sum_r |\Delta(f;a)^\wedge(r)|^4$ and on the proportion of $(a_1,\dots,a_{d-1})$ for which $\Delta(f; \cdot)$ is uniform.

nodes.name: Higher-uniformity AP-count bound
nodes.statement: If $f_1,\dots,f_k: \mathbb{Z}_N \to D$ and $f_k$ is $\alpha$-uniform of degree $k-2$, then $|\sum_r \sum_s f_1(s)\dots f_k(s-(k-1)r)| \le \alpha^{1/2^{k-1}} N^2$.

nodes.name: Approximate AP count for uniform sets
nodes.statement: If $A_i$ has cardinality $\delta_i N$ and is $\alpha^{2^{i-1}}$-uniform of degree $i-2$ for every $i \ge 3$, then $|\sum_r |(A_1+r)\cap\dots\cap(A_k+kr)| - \delta_1\dots\delta_k N^2| \le 2^k \alpha N^2$.

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz step-down on uniformity
nodes.statement: If $f$ is $\alpha$-uniform of degree $d$, then $f$ is $\alpha^{1/2}$-uniform of degree $d-1$.

nodes.name: Interval intersection estimate
nodes.statement: If $A$ is $\alpha$-uniform of cardinality $\delta N$ and $P$ is an interval of length $\beta N$, then $||A\cap P| - \beta\delta N| \le \alpha^{1/4} N$.

nodes.name: Higher uniformity implies APs
nodes.statement: If $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ is $\alpha$-uniform of degree $k-2$ with $|A| = \delta N$, $\alpha \le (\delta/2)^{k 2^k}$, and $N \ge 32k^2 \delta^{-k}$, then $A$ contains a $k$-term AP.

nodes.name: $d$-dimensional cube in $A$
nodes.statement: A function $\varphi: \{0,1\}^d \to A$ of the form $(\epsilon_1,\dots,\epsilon_d) \mapsto a_0 + \epsilon_1 a_1 + \dots + \epsilon_d a_d$ with $a_i \in \mathbb{Z}_N$.

nodes.name: Cube-count lower bound
nodes.statement: If $|A| = \delta N$ then $A$ contains at least $\delta^{2^d} N^{d+1}$ $d$-dimensional cubes.

nodes.name: Cauchy-Schwarz cube inequality
nodes.statement: For $\{f_\epsilon\}_{\epsilon \in \{0,1\}^k}$ from $\mathbb{Z}_N$ to $D$, $\sum_x \sum_s \prod_\epsilon C^{|\epsilon|} f_\epsilon(s-\epsilon\cdot x) \le \prod_\epsilon (\sum_x \sum_s \prod_\eta C^{|\eta|} f_\epsilon(s-\eta\cdot x))^{1/2^d}$.

nodes.name: $\|\cdot\|_d$ norm (Gowers norm)
nodes.statement: $\|f\|_d = (\sum_{x \in \mathbb{Z}_N^d} \sum_s \prod_\epsilon C^{|\epsilon|} f(s-\epsilon\cdot x))^{1/2^d}$ is a norm: $\|f+g\|_d \le \|f\|_d + \|g\|_d$.

nodes.name: Cube-count upper bound under uniformity
nodes.statement: If $A$ is $\alpha$-uniform of degree $d-1$ then $A$ contains at most $(\delta + \alpha^{1/2^d})^{2^d} N^{d+1}$ $d$-dimensional cubes.

nodes.name: Quadratic non-uniformity example $f(s) = \omega^{s^2}$
nodes.statement: $f(s) = \omega^{s^2}$ has $|\hat{f}(r)| = N^{1/2}$ (maximally uniform) but $\Delta(f;k)^\wedge(r)$ is $N$ at $r=2k$, showing $\Delta(f;k)$ is maximally non-uniform. Demonstrates uniformity does not imply quadratic uniformity.

nodes.name: Two-dimensional quadratic-form example
nodes.statement: Function $f$ defined via $\varphi(ar+b) = a^2+b^2$ (with $r \approx \sqrt{N}$) shows that even quadratic-bias hopes can fail; ruling out $\Delta(f;k)^\wedge(\lambda k)$ being large.

nodes.name: Uniform sets have $\ge$ expected APs of length 4
nodes.statement: If $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ has size $\delta N$ and is $\alpha$-uniform, then the number of 4-term APs in $A$ is $\ge (\delta^4 - \beta) N^2$, where $\beta \to 0$ as $\alpha \to 0$.

nodes.name: Even-length AP-count for higher-degree uniform sets
nodes.statement: For even $k$, if $A$ has size $\delta N$ and is $\alpha$-uniform of degree $k-1$, then the number of $(k+2)$-term APs in $A$ is $\ge (\delta^{k+2} - \beta) N^2$, with $\beta \to 0$ as $\alpha \to 0$.

nodes.name: Interval Fourier-coefficient bound
nodes.statement: For interval $I = [-M,M) \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$, $|\hat{I}(r)| \le \min\{2M, N/(2|r|)\}$.

nodes.name: Empty-intersection forces large Fourier coefficient
nodes.statement: If $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ has cardinality $t$ and $A \cap [-M,M) = \emptyset$ with $M$ even, then $\exists r$ with $0 < |r| \le N^2 M^{-2}$ and $|\hat{A}(r)| \ge tM/2N$.

nodes.name: Weyl's Inequality
nodes.statement: If $(a,q)=1$ and $|\alpha - a/q| \le q^{-2}$, then for $\epsilon > 0$, $|\sum_{s=1}^t e(\alpha s^k)| \le C_\epsilon t^{1+\epsilon}(q^{-1}+t^{-1}+qt^{-k})^{1/2^{k-1}}$. With $\epsilon = 1/k 2^{k+1}$ and $C_\epsilon = 1000$ when $t \ge 2^{2^{32k^2}}$.

nodes.name: Dirichlet's Approximation Lemma
nodes.statement: For any real $\alpha$ and integer $u \ge 1$ there exist $a, q$ with $(a,q)=1$, $1 \le q \le u$ and $|\alpha - a/q| \le 1/(qu)$.

nodes.name: Weyl-type recurrence in $\mathbb{Z}_N$
nodes.statement: Let $k \ge 2$, $t \ge 2^{2^{32k^2}}$, $N \ge t$, $a \in \mathbb{Z}_N$. There exists $p \le t$ with $|p^k a| \le t^{-1/k 2^{k+1}} N$.

nodes.name: Polynomial partition lemma
nodes.statement: For polynomial $\varphi$ of degree $k$, $K = (k!)^2 2^{(k+1)^2}$, $r$ large enough: $\{0,\dots,r-1\}$ partitions into $m \ge r^{1-1/K}$ APs whose images $\varphi(P_j)$ have diameter $\le r^{-1/K} N$.

nodes.name: Polynomial exponential-sum to AP partition
nodes.statement: Generalization of CP339.1 from linear to degree-$k$ polynomial $\varphi$: if $|\sum_{s=0}^{r-1} f(s)\omega^{-\varphi(s)}| \ge \alpha r$, then APs $P_j$ exist with $|\sum_{P_j} f| \ge (\alpha/2)r$ summed.

nodes.name: Polynomial bias gives density increment
nodes.statement: If disjoint APs $P_i$ cover $A$ and degree-$k$ polynomials $\varphi_i$ satisfy $\sum_i |\sum_{P_i} f \omega^{-\varphi_i}| \ge \alpha N$ (with sizes balanced), then there is an AP $Q$ of size $\ge (N/M)^{1/K}/8$ with $|A \cap Q| \ge (\delta + \alpha/8)|Q|$.

nodes.name: Multi-polynomial partition
nodes.statement: For polynomials $\varphi_1,\dots,\varphi_q$ of degree $\le k$ and large $r$: $\{0,\dots,r-1\}$ partitions into APs $P_j$ such that $\mathrm{diam}\,\varphi_i(P_j) \le r^{-1/K^q} N$ for all $i, j$.

nodes.name: Multilinear box partition
nodes.statement: For multilinear $\mu: P \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ on a box $P$ of width $\ge m$: $P$ partitions into boxes $P_j$ of width $\ge m^{K^{-2^k}}$ on which $\mathrm{diam}\,\mu(P_j) \le 2 m^{-K^{-2^k}} N$.

nodes.name: Multi-multilinear box partition
nodes.statement: For $q$ multilinear functions $\mu_1,\dots,\mu_q$ on a box $P$ of large width: $P$ partitions into sub-boxes on each of which all the $\mu_i$ have small diameter.

nodes.name: mod-$N$ to proper AP refinement
nodes.statement: A mod-$N$ AP of size $m$ partitions into $\le 4 m^{1/2}$ proper (genuine) APs.

nodes.name: Mod-$N$ AP partition refinement
nodes.statement: A mod-$N$ AP partition of $\mathbb{Z}_N$ into $M$ pieces has a proper-AP refinement of size $\le 4\sqrt{NM}$.

nodes.name: Polynomial-bias refinement
nodes.statement: If APs $Q_1,\dots,Q_M$ satisfy $\sum_i |\sum_{Q_i} f \omega^{-\varphi}| \ge \alpha N$ for polynomial $\varphi$ of degree $k$, then $\exists$ refinement $R_1,\dots,R_L$ with $L \le C M^{1/K} N^{1-1/K}$ and $\sum_j |\sum_{R_j} f| \ge (\alpha/2)N$.

nodes.name: Density-increment from partition
nodes.statement: If $f$ has mean zero and partition $\{P_i\}$ satisfies $\sum_j |\sum_{P_j} f| \ge \alpha N$, then $\exists j$ with $|\sum_{P_j} f| \ge (\alpha/4)|P_j|$ and $|P_j| \ge \alpha N/(4M)$.

nodes.name: Quadratic non-uniformity gives $\gamma$-additive function
nodes.statement: If $\sum_{k \in B} |\Delta(f;k)^\wedge(\varphi(k))|^2 \ge \alpha N^3$, then there are at least $\alpha^4 N^3$ quadruples $(a,b,c,d) \in B^4$ with $a+b=c+d$ and $\varphi(a)+\varphi(b)=\varphi(c)+\varphi(d)$.

nodes.name: $\gamma$-additive function
nodes.statement: $\varphi: B \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ is $\gamma$-additive if there are $\ge \gamma N^3$ quadruples $(a,b,c,d) \in B^4$ with $a+b=c+d$ and $\varphi(a)+\varphi(b)=\varphi(c)+\varphi(d)$.

nodes.name: Graph reformulation of additivity
nodes.statement: Let $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^2$ be the graph of $\gamma$-additive $\varphi$. Then $\Gamma$ contains $\ge \gamma N^3$ additive quadruples (in the group $\mathbb{Z}_N^2$).

nodes.name: Multi-dimensional progression as $\gamma$-additive function
nodes.statement: If $r_1\dots r_d = \beta N$ and $\varphi(\sum a_i x_i) = \sum a_i y_i$ on a $d$-dimensional progression, then $\varphi$ is $(2/3)^d \beta^3$-additive but cannot be approximated by a linear function.

nodes.name: Freiman's Theorem
nodes.statement: If $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$ with $|A| = m$ and $|A+A| \le Cm$, then there exist $d \le d_0(C)$, $K(C)$, and a $d$-dimensional AP of size $\le Km$ containing $A$.

nodes.name: Balog-Szemeredi Theorem
nodes.statement: If $A$ has $\|A * A\|_2^2 \ge c_0 m^3$, then there exist constants $c, K, d_0$ depending on $c_0$ and a $d$-dimensional AP $P$ of size $\le Km$ with $|A \cap P| \ge cm$.

nodes.name: Balog-Szemeredi without uniformity lemma
nodes.statement: If $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}^n$ with $\|A*A\|_2^2 \ge c_0 m^3$, then $\exists A' \subseteq A$ of size $\ge 2^{-20} c_0^{12} m$ with $|A'-A'| \le 2^{38} c_0^{-24} m$.

nodes.name: Combinatorial neighborhood lemma
nodes.statement: If $V$ has size $m$ and $A_1,\dots,A_n \subseteq V$ satisfy $\sum |A_x \cap A_y| \ge \delta^2 m n^2$, then there is $K \subseteq [n]$ of size $\ge 2^{-1/2}\delta^5 n$ with $\ge 90\%$ of pairs in $K^2$ having intersection size $\ge \delta^2 m/2$.

nodes.name: Freiman homomorphism of order $k$
nodes.statement: $\varphi: A \to B$ is a Freiman homomorphism of order $k$ if for $a_1+\dots+a_k = a_{k+1}+\dots+a_{2k}$ we always have $\varphi(a_1)+\dots+\varphi(a_k) = \varphi(a_{k+1})+\dots+\varphi(a_{2k})$.

nodes.name: Restriction to Freiman homomorphism
nodes.statement: If $\varphi: B \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ has graph $\Gamma$ with $|\Gamma - \Gamma| \le C|\Gamma|$, then $\exists B' \subseteq B$ with $|B'| \ge |B|/(8kC^{4k})$ on which $\varphi$ is a Freiman homomorphism of order $k$.

nodes.name: Somewhat-additive to Freiman homomorphism
nodes.statement: If $B_0 \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ has $|B_0| = \alpha N$ and $\varphi: B_0 \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ has $\gamma(\alpha N)^3$ additive quadruples, then $\exists B \subseteq B_0$ of size $\ge 2^{-1882}\gamma^{1164}\alpha N$ on which $\varphi$ is a homomorphism of order 8.

nodes.name: Bohr neighborhood $B(K, \delta)$
nodes.statement: For $K \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ and $\delta > 0$, $B(K, \delta) = \{d \in \mathbb{Z}_N : |sd| \le \delta N \text{ for every } s \in K\}$.

nodes.name: Bohr neighborhood size lower bound
nodes.statement: $|B(K, \delta)| \ge (\delta/2)^{|K|} N$. In particular if $\delta > (N/2)^{-1/|K|}$ then $B(K, \delta)$ contains a non-zero element.

nodes.name: Bogolyubov-style Bohr-homomorphism
nodes.statement: Let $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ of size $\alpha N$, $\varphi: A \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ a Freiman homomorphism of order 8, and $K = \{r: |\hat{A}(r)| \ge \alpha^{3/2} N/4\}$. Then $|K| \le 16 \alpha^{-2}$ and there is a homomorphism $\psi: B(K, \alpha/32\pi) \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ with $\varphi(x)-\varphi(y) = \psi(x-y)$ for $x,y \in A, x-y \in B(K, \alpha/32\pi)$.

nodes.name: Bohr-restriction is linear on short APs
nodes.statement: Under the hypotheses of LP339.26, for every $d \in B(K, \alpha/32\pi m)$ there is $c$ with $\varphi(x)-\varphi(y) = c(x-y)$ whenever $x-y \in \{jd: -m \le j \le m\}$.

nodes.name: $B$-homomorphism
nodes.statement: $\varphi: A \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ is a $B$-homomorphism if $\exists$ homomorphism $\psi: B \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ such that $x-y \in B$ implies $\varphi(x)-\varphi(y) = \psi(x-y)$.

nodes.name: Linear restriction on AP for somewhat-additive function
nodes.statement: If $B_0 \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ has size $\alpha N$ and $\varphi: B_0 \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ has $\gamma(\alpha N)^3$ additive quadruples, then $\exists$ mod-$N$ AP $P$ of length $\ge N^{2^{-3770}\gamma^{2328}\alpha^2}$, $H \subseteq P$ of size $\ge 2^{-1849}\gamma^{1164}\alpha|P|$, and $\lambda, \mu$ with $\varphi(s) = \lambda s + \mu$ on $H$.

nodes.name: Multi-function linear restriction on AP
nodes.statement: For arithmetic progression $R$ and order-8 homomorphisms $\varphi_i: A_i \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ (with $|A_i| \ge \alpha|R|$), $R$ partitions into APs $S_j$ of size $\sim m$ on each of which every $\varphi_i$ is linear, provided $m \le |R|^{2^{-14}\alpha^2 q^{-1}}$.

nodes.name: Quadratic-bias from linear-restriction on long AP
nodes.statement: If $\sum_{k \in P} |\Delta(f;k)^\wedge(\lambda k + \mu)|^2 \ge \beta N^2 T$ on AP $P$ of size $T$, then $\exists$ quadratic polynomials $\psi_s$ with $\sum_s |\sum_{z \in P+s} f(z) \omega^{-\psi_s(z)}| \ge \beta N T/\sqrt{2}$.

nodes.name: Szemeredi for length-4 APs
nodes.statement: There is an absolute constant $C$ such that if $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ has $|A| = \delta N$ and $N \ge \exp\exp((1/\delta)^C)$, then $A$ contains a 4-term AP.

nodes.name: Proof of length-4 Szemeredi
nodes.statement: If no 4-AP exists, $A$ is non-quadratically-uniform; CP339.4 gives a $\varphi$ with many large $\Delta$-Fourier coefficients; PrP339.1 gives a $\gamma$-additive function; CP339.11 gives a linear restriction on an AP; PrP339.3 produces quadratic bias; LP339.20-21 yield density increment; iterate.

nodes.name: Length-4 monochromatic AP under coloring
nodes.statement: There is an absolute constant $c > 0$ such that if $\{1,\dots,N\}$ is colored with $\le (\log\log N)^c$ colors, there is a monochromatic 4-term AP.

nodes.name: $\gamma$-homomorphism of order $k$
nodes.statement: $\varphi: B \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ is a $\gamma$-homomorphism of order $k$ if the proportion of sequences $(x_1,\dots,x_{2k}) \in B^{2k}$ with $x_1+\dots+x_k = x_{k+1}+\dots+x_{2k}$ that also satisfy $\varphi(x_1)+\dots+\varphi(x_k) = \varphi(x_{k+1})+\dots+\varphi(x_{2k})$ is $\ge \gamma$.

nodes.name: Hoelder fourth-power bound
nodes.statement: For non-negative $a_1,\dots,a_n$, $\sum a_i^4 \le (\sum a_i^2)^{6/7} (\sum a_i^{16})^{1/7}$.

nodes.name: Sixteenth-power additivity
nodes.statement: If $\varphi: B \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ is $\gamma$-additive, then there are $\ge \gamma^7 N^{15}$ sequences $a_1,\dots,a_{16}$ with $\sum_{i \le 8} a_i = \sum_{9 \le i \le 16} a_i$ and $\sum_{i \le 8} \varphi(a_i) = \sum_{9 \le i \le 16} \varphi(a_i)$.

nodes.name: Random restriction to approximate homomorphism
nodes.statement: Given $\varphi: B \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ with many sixteenth-order tuples, $\exists B'$ with at least $(\alpha\eta/4)^{2^{19}}\beta^{15} N^{15}$ such sequences such that the restriction of $\varphi$ to $B'$ is a $(1-\eta)$-homomorphism of order 8.

nodes.name: Somewhat-additive to approximate homomorphism
nodes.statement: If $\varphi: B \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ is $\gamma\beta^3$-additive, $\exists B' \subseteq B$ such that the restriction of $\varphi$ to $B'$ is a $(1-\eta)$-homomorphism of order 8 with at least $(\gamma^7 \beta^6 \eta/4)^{2^{19}}\beta^{15} N^{15}$ relevant tuples.

nodes.name: Domain (multifunction)
nodes.statement: A domain is a set $X$ with a partition $X = \bigcup_r X_r$, equivalently a function $r: X \to \mathbb{Z}_N$. A multifunction $\varphi: X \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ is a pair $(r, \varphi)$.

nodes.name: $(B, L)$-invariance
nodes.statement: Domain $X$ is $(B,L)$-invariant if for every $r \in \mathbb{Z}_N$ and $d \in B$, $||X_{r+d}| - |X_r|| \le L$.

nodes.name: Bounds on $q(x,y)$
nodes.statement: $q(x,y) = \sum_d |X_{r(x)+d}||X_{r(y)+d}| \le \alpha M^2 N$, $\sum_y q(x,y) \le \alpha^2 M^3 N^2$, and $\sum_{x,y} q(x,y) \ge \alpha^4 M^4 N^3$.

nodes.name: Most error on light edges
nodes.statement: If $\sigma \le \eta\alpha^2$, then $\sum_{x,y} \epsilon(x,y) q(x,y) \le 15\eta \sum_{x,y} q(x,y)$.

nodes.name: Existence of good base point $x$
nodes.statement: $\exists x \in X$ with $R(x) \ge \alpha^2 M/2$, $Q(x) \ge \alpha^3 M^3 N^2 /4$, and $E(x) \le 60\eta Q(x)$.

nodes.name: Smoothness of $q$ on $B$
nodes.statement: If $r(z)-r(y) \in B$, then $|q(z)-q(y)| \le \sigma\alpha M^2 N$.

nodes.name: Construction of well-behaved subset $W$
nodes.statement: $\exists W \subseteq X$ that is a union of $X_r$'s, with $q$ varying by factor $\le 2$ on $W$, $\epsilon \le 300\eta^{1/2}$ on most of $W$, $|W| \ge \rho^2 \alpha^2 M N/16$, $R$ varying by factor 2 (at least $\alpha^2 M/16$), and $|W \cap (W+d)| \ge (1-\eta)|W|$ for $d \in B$.

nodes.name: Local difference function $\psi$ exists on most of $B$
nodes.statement: $\exists B' \subseteq B$ of size $\ge (1-10\eta^{1/5})|B|$ and $\psi: B' \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ such that for almost every $w \in W$ and $z \in X_{r(w)+d}$, $\varphi(z)-\varphi(w) = \psi(d)$.

nodes.name: Symmetric form of LP339.35
nodes.statement: Variant of LP339.35: for most $w \in W$, the equation $\varphi(w')-\varphi(w) = \psi(d)$ holds for most $d \in B'$ and most $w' \in X_{r(w)+d}$.

nodes.name: Shift lemma
nodes.statement: If $P$ is a property of $W$ holding for $(1-\theta)$-a.e. $w$, then for $(1-\theta^{1/2}-\eta)$-a.e. $w \in W$, $(1-2\theta^{1/2})$-a.e. $w' \in X_{r(w)+d}$ has $P(w')$.

nodes.name: $\psi$ is a Freiman homomorphism
nodes.statement: Under $\theta = 10\eta^{1/5}$ with $6\theta^{1/2} < 1$, the function $\psi: B' \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ from LP339.35 is a Freiman homomorphism.

nodes.name: Bohr-shift size estimate
nodes.statement: Let $K$ have size $k$, $B = B(K, \delta)$, $d \in B(K, \zeta)$. Then $|B \cap (B+d)| \ge (1 - 2^{k+1}\delta^{-k} k\zeta)|B|$.

nodes.name: Smaller Bohr neighborhood gives induced homomorphism
nodes.statement: Let $B = B(K, \delta)$, $B' \subseteq B$ with $|B'| \ge (7/8)|B|$, $\zeta = 2^{-(k+4)}\delta^k k$, $C = B(K, \zeta)$. Then $C \subseteq B' - B'$ and any homomorphism $\psi: B' \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ induces a homomorphism $\psi_1: C \to \mathbb{Z}_N$.

nodes.name: Difference relation on $W_1$ via $\psi_1$
nodes.statement: If $w_1, w_2 \in W_1$ (the regular subset) and $r(w_1)-r(w_2) \in C = B(K, \zeta)$, then $\varphi(w_1) - \varphi(w_2) = \psi_1(r(w_1)-r(w_2))$.

nodes.name: Approximate-homomorphism Bohr-restriction theorem
nodes.statement: Let $\eta = 2^{-43}$, $X$ the domain of a $(1-\eta)$-homomorphism $\varphi$ of order 8, $g(s) = |X_s|$, $\lambda = 2^{-37}\alpha^{11/2}$, $K = \{r: |\hat{g}(r)| \ge \lambda M\}$, $C = B(K, \zeta)$. Then $\exists$ homomorphism $\psi_1: C \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ and $Y \subseteq X$ of size $\ge \alpha^3 |X|/1000$ with $\varphi(y)-\varphi(z) = \psi_1(r(y)-r(z))$ when $y, z \in Y$ and $r(y)-r(z) \in C$.

nodes.name: Linear restriction of $\varphi$ on short APs
nodes.statement: Under TP339.9, for every $d \in B(K, \zeta/m)$ there exists $c$ such that $\varphi(x)-\varphi(y) = c(r(x)-r(y))$ whenever $x, y \in Y$ and $r(x)-r(y) \in \{jd: -m \le j \le m\}$.

nodes.name: Vertical parallelogram and $\varphi(P)$
nodes.statement: A vertical parallelogram is $((x,y), (x,y+h), (x+w,y'), (x+w,y'+h))$ with width $w$ and height $h$. $\varphi(P) = \varphi(x,y) - \varphi(x,y+h) - \varphi(x+w,y') + \varphi(x+w,y'+h)$.

nodes.name: Multi-function additive-quadruple bound (Proposition 12.1)
nodes.statement: If $\sum_k \lambda_k \prod_{i=1}^p |\Delta(f_i;k)^\wedge(\varphi_i(k))|^2 \ge \alpha N^{2p+1}$, then $\sum \lambda_a\lambda_b\lambda_c\lambda_d \ge \alpha^4 N^3$ over simultaneously-additive quadruples $(a,b,c,d)$.

nodes.name: Many parallelogram pairs
nodes.statement: If $|B| = \beta N^2$ and $|\Delta(f;k,l)^\wedge(\varphi(k,l))| \ge \gamma N$ on $B$, then there are $\ge \beta^{16}\gamma^{48} N^8$ pairs $(P_1, P_2)$ of vertical parallelograms with same width, height, and $\varphi(P_1) = \varphi(P_2)$.

nodes.name: $d$-arrangement and respect by $\varphi$
nodes.statement: A $d$-arrangement of height $h$ is points $((x_i,y_i),(x_i,y_i+h))_{i=1}^{2d}$ with $x_1+\dots+x_d = x_{d+1}+\dots+x_{2d}$. $\varphi$ respects it if $\sum_{i \le d} \varphi_h(x_i,y_i) = \sum_{d < i \le 2d} \varphi_h(x_i,y_i)$ where $\varphi_h(x,y) = \varphi(x,y+h)-\varphi(x,y)$.

nodes.name: Sixteenth-power 8-arrangement count
nodes.statement: If $\theta N^8$ pairs of parallelograms exist with matching widths/heights/$\varphi$, then $\ge \theta^7 N^{32}$ 8-arrangements respected by $\varphi$.

nodes.name: Combining LP339.41 and LP339.42
nodes.statement: Under the hypotheses of LP339.41, $\ge \beta^{112}\gamma^{336} N^{32}$ 8-arrangements are respected by $\varphi$.

nodes.name: Random restriction with Riesz products (8-arrangement version)
nodes.statement: If $\varphi$ respects $\alpha\beta^{15} N^{32}$ 8-arrangements in $B$, then $\exists B' \subseteq B$ containing $\ge (\alpha\eta/4)^{2^{36}} \beta^{15} N^{32}$ 8-arrangements such that the proportion respected by $\varphi$ is $\ge 1-\eta$.

nodes.name: Main result of Section 12 (almost-respected 8-arrangements)
nodes.statement: Under the standing assumption $|\Delta(f;k,l)^\wedge(\varphi(k,l))| \ge \gamma N$ on $|B| = \beta N^2$, $\exists B' \subseteq B$ containing $\ge 2^{-2^{37}}\beta^{2^{43}}\gamma^{2^{45}}\eta^{2^{36}} N^{32}$ 8-arrangements with $1-\eta$ proportion respected by $\varphi$.

nodes.name: Generalized $\sigma$-additive count (Lemma 13.1)
nodes.statement: For $f: \mathbb{Z}_N^2 \to D$, if $\sum_{h \in B} |\hat{f_h}(\sigma(h))|^2 \ge \alpha N^5$, then $\ge \alpha^4 N^3$ quadruples $(a,b,c,d) \in B^4$ with $a+b=c+d$ and $\sigma(a)+\sigma(b) = \sigma(c)+\sigma(d)$.

nodes.name: Linear coverage of large Fourier coefficients
nodes.statement: $\exists$ Freiman homomorphisms $\sigma_1,\dots,\sigma_q$ on $B_i \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ and $G \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ of size $\ge (1-\theta)N$ such that whenever $h \in G$ and $|\hat{f_h}(r)| \ge \theta N^2$, $r = \sigma_i(h)$ for some $i$.

nodes.name: AP with linear $\sigma_i$ coefficients
nodes.statement: $\exists$ AP $P$ of length $m_0$ and subset $H \subseteq P$ with $\sum_{h \in H} C(h) \ge \alpha^{32} N^{31} m_0/8$, plus constants $a_i, b_i$ such that $|\hat{f_h}(r)| \ge \theta N$ implies $r = a_i h + b_i$ on $H$.

nodes.name: Common-difference quadratic-recurrence refinement
nodes.statement: $\exists$ AP $Q \subseteq P$ of size $m_1$ and common difference $d$ such that $|(a_i h + b_i)d| \le m_0^{-1/2^{11q}} N$ for all $i$, with at least $\alpha^{32} m_1/20$ regular $h$'s.

nodes.name: Linear restriction on AP (per-$h$)
nodes.statement: $\exists$ AP $R$ such that for every $h \in I$, the restriction of $\varphi_h$ to $\{v \in Y_h: r(v) \in R\}$ is linear, with $\sum_h |\{v \in Y_h: r(v) \in R\}| \ge 2^{-31}\alpha^{160} m_1 m_2 N$.

nodes.name: Linear restriction to $S$ in $x$
nodes.statement: $\exists y$, AP $S \subseteq R$ of size $m_3$, and $B \subseteq S \times (I+y)$ of size $\ge 2^{-31}\alpha^{160} m_1 m_3$ such that $\varphi(x, y+h)$ is linear in $x$ on $B$ for every $h \in I$.

nodes.name: Coefficient map is order-8 homomorphism on $J$
nodes.statement: $\exists J \subseteq I$ such that $h \mapsto (a(h), c(h))$ is an order-8 homomorphism on $J$, with $|C| \ge 2^{-84}\alpha^{416} m_1 m_3$.

nodes.name: Bilinear restriction on subprogression
nodes.statement: $\exists$ AP $U \subseteq Q$ of size $m_4$ such that the set $D$ of $(x,y+h) \in C$ with $h \in U \cap J$ has size $\ge 2^{-84}\alpha^{416} m_3 m_4$ and $\varphi$ is bilinear on $D$.

nodes.name: Bilinear restriction on equal-length AP product
nodes.statement: $\exists$ APs $V, W$ with same common difference and $|V| = |W| = m_5 \ge \sqrt{m_4} - 1$, and $E \subseteq V \times W$ of size $\ge 2^{-86}\alpha^{416}|V||W|$ such that $\varphi$ restricted to $E$ is bilinear.

nodes.name: Setup for bilinear extraction (Lemma 13.11)
nodes.statement: If $f: \mathbb{Z}_N \to D$ fails to be cubically $\alpha$-uniform, then $\exists A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^2$ of size $\ge (\alpha/2)^{2^{66}} N^2$ and $\varphi: A \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ that is an order-8 homomorphism in each variable, respects $\ge 1-2^{-73}$ proportion of 8-arrangements, and has $|\Delta(f;k,l)^\wedge(\varphi(k,l))| \ge \alpha N/2$.

nodes.name: Bilinear piece for cubic non-uniformity (weak bilinear Freiman)
nodes.statement: If $f: \mathbb{Z}_N \to D$ is not cubically $\alpha$-uniform, then $\exists$ APs $P, Q$ of size $\ge N^{(1/2)^{(1/\alpha)^{2^{70}}}}$ with same common difference, $B \subseteq P \times Q$ of size $\ge (\alpha/2)^{2^{76}} |P||Q|$, and bilinear $\varphi: P \times Q \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ with $|\Delta(f;k,l)^\wedge(\varphi(k,l))| \ge \alpha N/2$ on $B$.
conclusions: $\exists$ APs $P, Q$, $B \subseteq P \times Q$, bilinear $\varphi$ with given size/Fourier-coefficient properties

nodes.name: Multi-function product property (Proposition 14.1)
nodes.statement: If $\sum_h \lambda_h \prod_{i \le p} |\hat{f_h^{(i)}}(\sigma_i(h))|^2 \ge \alpha N^{4p+1}$, then $\sum \lambda_a\lambda_b\lambda_c\lambda_d \ge \alpha^4 N^3$ over quadruples with $a+b=c+d$ and $\sigma_i(a)+\sigma_i(b) = \sigma_i(c)+\sigma_i(d)$ for all $i$.

nodes.name: Product property with parameter $\gamma$
nodes.statement: $\varphi: B \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ ($B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^k$) has the product property with parameter $\gamma$ if for any $j$-restrictions $\psi_1,\dots,\psi_p$, any common domain $E$, and weight $\theta$, $\sum \theta(a)\theta(b)\theta(c)\theta(d) \ge \gamma^{8p} N^{-1}(\sum_x \theta(x))^4$ over quadruples that are $\psi_i$-additive for all $i$.

nodes.name: Difference-Fourier gives product property (Lemma 14.2)
nodes.statement: If $|\Delta(f; r_1,\dots,r_k)^\wedge(\varphi(r_1,\dots,r_k))| \ge \gamma N$ on $B$, then $\varphi$ has the product property with parameter $\gamma$.

nodes.name: $\hat{f_z}$ large implies product property (Lemma 14.3)
nodes.statement: Variant: if $|\hat{f_z}(\varphi(z))| \ge \gamma N^{k+1}$ on $B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^k$ (for $f: \mathbb{Z}_N^{k+1} \to D$), then $\varphi$ has the product property with parameter $\gamma$.

nodes.name: Configuration, cube, parallelepiped pair, $d$-arrangement (multi-dim)
nodes.statement: Cube $[r_1,\dots,r_k; h_1,\dots,h_k]$ with sidelengths $h_i$. Configuration is a product of $k$ additive quadruples. Parallelepiped pair: 4 congruent cubes in cross-sections forming an additive quadruple of cross-section indices. $d$-arrangement: $2d$ congruent cubes whose cross-section indices form an additive $2d$-tuple.

nodes.name: Product property gives respected configurations
nodes.statement: If $|B| = \beta N^k$ and $\varphi: B \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ has product property with parameter $\gamma$, then $\varphi$ respects $\ge \beta^{4^k} \gamma^{2k \cdot 4^k} N^{3k}$ configurations.

nodes.name: Respected cube pairs
nodes.statement: Under the hypotheses of LP339.56, $\varphi$ respects $\ge \beta^{4^k}\gamma^{2k \cdot 4^k} N^{3k}$ cube pairs in $B$.

nodes.name: Respected parallelepiped pairs
nodes.statement: If $|B| = \beta N^{k+1}$ and $\varphi$ has the product property with parameter $\gamma$, then $\varphi$ respects $\ge \beta^{4^{k+1}} \gamma^{k \cdot 4^{k+1}} N^{5k+3}$ parallelepiped pairs.

nodes.name: Parallelepiped pairs to 8-arrangements (multi-dim)
nodes.statement: If $\varphi$ respects $\theta N^{5k+3}$ parallelepiped pairs in $B$, then $\varphi$ respects $\ge \theta^7 N^{17k+15}$ 8-arrangements in $B$.

nodes.name: Many respected 8-arrangements (Lemma 14.8)
nodes.statement: If $|B| = \beta N^{k+1}$ and $\varphi$ has product property $\gamma$, then $\varphi$ respects $\ge \beta^{7 \cdot 4^{k+1}}\gamma^{7k \cdot 4^{k+1}} N^{17k+15}$ 8-arrangements.

nodes.name: Walsh-basis non-degeneracy (Lemma 15.1)
nodes.statement: If $\sum_\epsilon \eta(\epsilon)\prod_{i \in A}(y_i + \epsilon_i h_i)$ is independent of $y_1,\dots,y_k$ for every $A \subseteq [k]$, then $\eta: \{-1,1\}^k \to \{-1,0,1\}$ is a multiple of $\epsilon \mapsto \prod \epsilon_i$.

nodes.name: Parity-function characterization
nodes.statement: Same as LP339.59 with substitution $y_i \to y_i - h_i$, $h_i \to 2h_i$: on $\{0,1\}^k$, only multiples of the parity function satisfy the independence condition.

nodes.name: Multilinear function fiber size
nodes.statement: If $\mu: \mathbb{Z}_N^k \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ is a non-constant multilinear function, then $|\mu^{-1}(a)| \le N^k - (N-1)^k \le k N^{k-1}$.

nodes.name: Few degenerate $d$-arrangements
nodes.statement: The number of degenerate $d$-arrangements in $\mathbb{Z}_N^{k+1}$ is at most $3^{2d \cdot 2^k} k N^{(2d+1)k+2d-2}$.

nodes.name: Random restriction (8-arrangement, multi-dim)
nodes.statement: If $\varphi$ respects $\alpha\beta^{15} N^{17k+15}$ 8-arrangements in $B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^{k+1}$ (size $\beta N^{k+1}$), then $\exists B'$ with $\ge (\alpha\eta/4)^{2^{2^{k+4}+k+3}} \beta^{15} N^{17k+15}$ 8-arrangements and $\ge 1-\eta$ respected proportion.

nodes.name: Combination lemma (Lemma 15.6)
nodes.statement: If $|B| = \beta N^{k+1}$ and $\varphi$ has product property $\gamma$, then $\exists B' \subseteq B$ with $\ge (\beta\gamma/2)^{2^{2k+5}} N^{17k+15}$ 8-arrangements and $\ge 1-2^{-44}$ respected.

nodes.name: Box partition for multi-multilinear $\mu_i$
nodes.statement: For multilinear $\mu_1,\dots,\mu_q$ on box $P$ in $\mathbb{Z}_N^k$, $P$ partitions into boxes $P_j$ of width $\ge m^{K^{-2^{k+1}q}}$ such that each $|\mu_i(x) d_j| \le 2 m^{-K^{-2^{k+1}q}} N$ on $P_j$.

nodes.name: $(\gamma, r)$-multiply $k$-linear
nodes.statement: $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^k \times \mathbb{Z}_N$ is $(\gamma, r)$-multiply $k$-linear if for every $\theta > 0$ and box $P$ of width $m$, $\exists H \subseteq P$ of size $\ge (1-\theta)|P|$ and a partition of $P$ into boxes of width $\ge m^{c(r^{-1}\theta,\gamma,k)^r}$ such that on each, $\Gamma$ is contained in the union of $\le q(r^{-1}\theta,\gamma,k)^r$ graphs of $k$-linear functions (modulo $H$).

nodes.name: Main inductive structural theorem (Theorem 16.2)
nodes.statement: If $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^k \times \mathbb{Z}_N$ has $|\Gamma| \le \gamma^{-2} N^k$ and product property $\gamma$, then for every $\theta > 0$ there is $J \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^k$ of size $\ge (1-\theta)N^k$ such that $\Gamma \cap (J \times \mathbb{Z}_N)$ is $(\gamma, \gamma^{-2} s(\theta,\gamma,k))$-multiply $k$-linear.
conclusions: For every $\theta > 0$, $\exists J$ of size $\ge (1-\theta)N^k$ with $\Gamma \cap (J \times \mathbb{Z}_N)$ being $(\gamma, \gamma^{-2} s(\theta,\gamma,k))$-multiply $k$-linear

nodes.name: Proof of TP339.11 (induction on $k$)
nodes.statement: Induction: base $k=1$ via somewhat-additive analysis (CP339.9, CP339.12); inductive step via Lemmas 16.4-16.10 establishing $(\gamma, 1)$-multilinearity of cross-sections, then iteratively peeling off $(\gamma, 1)$-multilinear subsets.

nodes.name: Base case k=1 of TP339.11 (Lemma 16.3)
nodes.statement: Theorem 16.2 holds for $k=1$: a graph satisfying the product property with size bound has, away from a small set, structure as a union of order-8 homomorphisms each of which restricts linearly on subprogressions.

nodes.name: Inductive step setup (Lemma 16.4)
nodes.statement: Either $\Gamma$ has small projection or $\exists B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^{k+1}$ and $\varphi$ such that proper cross-sections of $\varphi$ are multiply multilinear, $B$ contains many 8-arrangements, and $1-\eta$ are respected by $\varphi$.

nodes.name: Bohr-homomorphism on $Y_h$ (Lemma 16.5)
nodes.statement: There exists $H \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^k$ such that $\sum_{h \in H} C(h)$ is large, and for every $h \in H$ there is $Y_h \subseteq X_h$ with $\varphi$ restricted to $Y_h$ being a $B(K_h, \zeta)$-homomorphism.

nodes.name: Linear $x \to \varphi'(h, x)$ on small intervals (Lemma 16.6)
nodes.statement: $\exists G \subseteq Q$ of large size and partition into boxes $S_u = T_u \times J_u$ such that $x \to \varphi'(h, x)$ is linear on $J_u$ for $h \in G \cap H_1 \cap T_u$.

nodes.name: Existence of base point $x_1,\dots,x_k$ (Lemma 16.7)
nodes.statement: $\exists x_1,\dots,x_k$ such that for $\ge \theta_2 N^{k+1}$ choices of $(h_1,\dots,h_k,x)$, $\varphi'(h, x)$ equals the alternating sum $\sum_\epsilon (-1)^{|\epsilon|}\varphi(x_1+\epsilon_1 h_1,\dots,x)$.

nodes.name: Multilinearity preservation (Lemma 16.8)
nodes.statement: If $\Gamma_1,\dots,\Gamma_r$ are $(\gamma,s)$-multiply $(k+1)$-linear, then $\Gamma_1 \cup \dots \cup \Gamma_r$ is $(\gamma, rs)$-multiply $(k+1)$-linear; same for sums of $(\gamma, s)$-multilinear functions.

nodes.name: Box-wise linear graph for $\varphi_1$ (Lemma 16.9)
nodes.statement: $\exists E \subseteq P$ of size $\ge (1-\sigma)|P|$ and partition into boxes $S_u = T_u \times J_u$ such that for each $u$ and $h \in T_u$, the graph of $\psi_{u,h}(x) = \varphi_1(h,x)$ is contained in the union of $\le q$ linear functions.

nodes.name: $(\gamma, 1)$-multiply multilinearity of $\varphi_1$ (Lemma 16.10)
nodes.statement: The function $\varphi_1$ is itself $(\gamma, 1)$-multiply $(k+1)$-linear.

nodes.name: Multilinear piece for $(k+1)$-uniformity failure (Corollary 16.11)
nodes.statement: If $f: \mathbb{Z}_N \to D$ fails to be $\alpha$-uniform of degree $k+1$, then $\exists$ box $P \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N^k$ of width $\ge N^{(\alpha/2)^{2^{2^{k+9}}}}$ and multilinear $\mu: P \to \mathbb{Z}_N$ with $|\Delta(f;y_1,\dots,y_k)^\wedge(\mu(y_1,\dots,y_k))| \ge (\alpha/2)N$ for $\ge (\alpha/2)^{2^{2^{k+9}}}|P|$ values of $(y_1,\dots,y_k) \in P$.

nodes.name: Polynomial expansion of multilinear (Lemma 17.1)
nodes.statement: For a $k$-linear $\sigma$ over $\mathbb{Z}_N$, $\exists$ polynomials $\varphi_\epsilon$ ($\epsilon \in \{0,1\}^k$) of degree $\le k$ with $\varphi(x_1,\dots,x_k) = \sum_\epsilon (-1)^{|\epsilon|}\varphi_\epsilon(s - \epsilon \cdot x)$.

nodes.name: Polynomial-bias from full multilinear function
nodes.statement: If $\sum_x |\Delta(f;x)^\wedge(\sigma(x))|^2 \ge \alpha N^{k+2}$ for $k$-linear $\sigma$ on $\mathbb{Z}_N^k$, then $\exists$ polynomial $\varphi$ of degree $\le k$ with $g(s) = f(s)\omega^{-\varphi(s)}$ satisfying $\sum_x |\sum_s \Delta(g;x)(s)|^2 \ge \alpha N^{k+2}$.

nodes.name: VC-dim of half-spaces (Lemma 17.4)
nodes.statement: The number of distinct regions defined by $m$ hyperplanes in $\mathbb{R}^k$ is $\le \sum_{j=0}^k \binom{m}{j}$, with equality in general position.

nodes.name: Counting linear functions on $\{0,1\}^k$ (Corollary 17.5)
nodes.statement: For $\alpha_i \in (-r, r)$, the number of distinct functions $f: \{0,1\}^k \to \mathbb{Z}$, $f(\epsilon) = \epsilon \cdot \alpha$, is $\le 2^{2rk^3}$.

nodes.name: Counting affine functions mod $M$ (Corollary 17.6)
nodes.statement: For $\alpha_0$ arbitrary and $\alpha_i \in (-r,r)$, the number of distinct $f: \{0,1\}^k \to \mathbb{Z}_M$, $f(\epsilon) = \alpha_0 + \epsilon\cdot\alpha \pmod{M}$ is $\le M \cdot 2^{2r(k+1)^3}$.

nodes.name: $\alpha$-uniform of degree $k$ wrt partition
nodes.statement: $f$ is $\alpha$-uniform of degree $k$ wrt partition $Q_1,\dots,Q_M$ (each of length $\le m$) if $\sum_i \sum_{x,s} \Delta(Q_i f; x)(s) \le \alpha m^{k+2} M$.

nodes.name: Polynomial-bias from box-multilinear (Proposition 17.7)
nodes.statement: If $\sum_{x \in P} |\Delta(f;x)^\wedge(\sigma(x))|^2 \ge \alpha N^2 m^k$ for $k$-linear $\sigma$ on a box $P$ of length $m \le N^{1/2}$, then $\exists$ polynomial $\varphi$ of degree $\le k+1$ and partition into mod-$N$ APs of size $\ge m/3k$ such that $g(x) = f(x)\omega^{-\varphi(x)}$ is not $2^{-2(k+1)^3}\alpha$-uniform of degree $k$ wrt this partition.

nodes.name: Density-increment from non-uniformity (Theorem 18.1)
nodes.statement: If $\alpha \le 1/2$ and $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N$ is not $\alpha$-uniform of degree $k$, then $\exists$ partition of $\mathbb{Z}_N$ into APs $P_1,\dots,P_M$ of average size $\ge N^{\alpha^{2^{2^{k+10}}}}$ with $\sum_j |\sum_{P_j} f(s)| \ge \alpha^{2^{2^{k+10}}} N$.
conclusions: AP partition with stated average size and large sum bound

nodes.name: Proof of TP339.12 (induction on $k$)
nodes.statement: Combine CP339.22 (multilinear piece) with PrP339.7 (polynomial-bias partition) and induction; use LP339.19 to refine, LP339.20 for further refinement, LP339.21 for density increment.

nodes.name: Main Theorem (Theorem 18.2)
nodes.statement: Let $0 < \delta \le 1/2$, $k \ge 1$, $N \ge 2 \uparrow 2 \uparrow \delta^{-1} \uparrow 2 \uparrow 2 \uparrow (k+9)$. Every $A \subseteq \{1,\dots,N\}$ with $|A| \ge \delta N$ contains an AP of length $k$.

nodes.name: Proof of Main Theorem (Theorem 18.2)
nodes.statement: If $A$ is sufficiently uniform (CP339.4) we are done; else by TP339.12 + LP339.21 there is a subprogression with density increment $(\delta + \alpha^{2^{2^{k+8}}})$. Iterate $\le \alpha^{-2^{2^{k+8}}}$ times; at each stage $N$ is raised to a power $\ge \alpha^{2^{2^{k+8}}}$. Initial $N \ge$ tower height bound suffices.

nodes.name: Reduce to $\alpha$-uniform of degree $k-2$
nodes.statement: Set $\alpha = (\delta/2)^{k 2^k}$. If $A$ is $\alpha$-uniform of degree $k-2$, CP339.4 gives the AP directly.

nodes.name: Density-increment via TP339.12 + LP339.21
nodes.statement: If $A$ fails $\alpha$-uniformity of degree $k-2$, TP339.12 partitions $\mathbb{Z}_N$; LP339.21 then yields a long subprogression $P$ with $|A \cap P| \ge (\delta + \alpha^{2^{2^{k+8}}})|P|$.

nodes.name: Iterate density-increment
nodes.statement: Apply PSP339.2 repeatedly. After $\le \alpha^{-2^{2^{k+8}}}$ iterations the density doubles, eventually exceeding 1, so an AP must appear.

nodes.name: Verify N large enough at each iteration
nodes.statement: Each iteration requires $N \ge 32 k^2 \delta^{-k}$. Since each step raises $N$ to power $\ge \alpha^{2^{2^{k+8}}}$, the initial tower-height bound suffices.

nodes.name: Tower-bound van der Waerden
nodes.statement: If $N \ge 2 \uparrow 2 \uparrow 2 \uparrow 2 \uparrow 2 \uparrow (k+9)$, then any 2-coloring of $\{1,\dots,N\}$ has a monochromatic AP of length $k$. This proves Graham's tower-of-twos conjecture for $k \ge 9$.

nodes.name: Comparison with Roth/Furstenberg/Szemeredi
nodes.statement: This paper gives the first quantitative bound for general $k$ via Fourier-analytic + additive-combinatorial methods, generalizing Roth's argument for $k=3$. Furstenberg's ergodic-theoretic proof gives no bound; Szemeredi's combinatorial proof yields tower-type bounds via the regularity lemma.

nodes.name: Difficulty progression with $k$
nodes.statement: The difficulty increases sharply from $k=3$ (linear) to $k=4$ (quadratic) to $k=5$ (bilinear), then remains roughly constant. The transition is the move from one variable to two in the inverse-problem analysis.

nodes.name: Erdos's $1/x$-divergence conjecture
nodes.statement: Every set $X$ of positive integers with $\sum_{x \in X} 1/x = \infty$ contains arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions. (In particular, the primes.)

nodes.name: Multidimensional Szemeredi quantitative bound
nodes.statement: Even for the case of corners $\{(a,b),(a+d,b),(a,b+d)\}$ in $[N]^2$ no good (sub-tower) bound is known.
